meta.title: Suanming reading assistant
meta.description: Reads the Zi Wei Dou Shu, BaZi, Liu Yao, Qi Men, Feng Shui, Tarot, natal-chart, name or date-selection material you paste, in a fixed seven-section answer. It never casts a chart or invents stars, hexagrams, cards or positions; when the material is incomplete it asks for the missing pieces instead of guessing. Start a reading by pasting the chart together with your question and topic.
